findings.location: DESIGN §3 notAmended vs §5 model and vectors
findings.finding: notAmended is described as 'named, not pinned, as HS53 did'. But the model checks that 'notAmended files are byte-identical to the base', and a vector refuses 'an edited not-amended file'. For living catalogs (LBR and R12D now; 00-harness-engineering.md and task-packets/README.md once S1-2 is fixed, both of which LPK-0 edits) these two rules contradict each other. HS53 left the living catalogs unpinned on purpose, 'so that a catalog edit never needs an HS53 successor'.
findings.requiredChange: Split notAmended into pinned entries (packet YAML, closed records, pinned guides: byte-identical at the era) and named-only entries (living catalogs and snapshots: not byte-checked). Restrict the model check and the vector to the pinned group.

findings.finding: MDP, which LPK-0 edits, keeps current-position text that contradicts the record. The phase table has CONF-FIX-010 BLOCKED_SAFE_DESIGN and CONF-LIVE-004/005/006 'Native probes, package handoff...' (HO:docs/MASTER_DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md:2257-2258). (:2348-2350). The current status lines in HO:docs/DEVELOPMENT_STATUS.md:21-22 and HO:docs/alpha-2/LIVE_BACKEND_READINESS.md:13-14 are also affected. The design does not say what the catalog edits contain.

Say whether DS and LBR current lines are left for a later packet, and why.

findings.finding: The design rests the KAP deferral on 'LX-D1', and the brief lists LX-D1 among the verbatim decisions. OWNER_DECISIONS.md (d67b525d) contains no LX-D1 text: LX-D1 appears only inside the Q-PK-4 and Q-LPK0-3 quotes. findings.requiredChange: Have the monitor append LX-D1 verbatim to OWNER_DECISIONS.md before the contract build, or quote only Q-LPK0-3 ('KAP stays deferred and unowned, per LX-D1') as the authority.

findings.finding: Missing checks. (a) Completeness: nothing in the record lists the pinned statements it was meant to cover, so a missed clause (as in S1-1 to S1-3) cannot be detected. (b) Replacement content: nothing checks that each replacement names LINUX-PROBE-KIT-001 for moved items, names DEFERRED_UNOWNED for KAP, and never hands a moved item to an R12 packet. (c) Supersedes rows lack HS53's `items` link, so 'every moved item is superseded wherever pinned' cannot be checked in either direction. (d) The status vocabulary (SUPERSEDED_UNACCEPTED_HISTORY, NON_DISPATCHABLE_RETAINED_HISTORY, DEFERRED_UNOWNED) is not a closed enum. (e) Duplicate or overlapping rows are not checked.
findings.requiredChange: Add an `inventory` member: the declared search (for example every base line naming CONF-LIVE-00[345] or a short 003/004/005 form in docs/ and architecture/), with one disposition per hit: superseded row, notAmended class, or not-ownership with a reason. The model refuses any hit without a disposition. Add `items` to the rows and the checks for (b), (d) and (e). New negative vectors: a hit with no disposition, a replacement naming an R12 packet as owner, a row with no item, and a moved item with no row.

findings.finding: The table is acyclic and matches PK-D1 and the slots (262 after 261, LPK-1 after both, LPK-2 after LPK-1). It is incomplete in four places.
